extraMeanings.en: a large increase in prices, taxes, or interest rates
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There was a sharp hike in fuel prices last month.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Geçen ay yakıt fiyatlarında keskin bir zam oldu.

extraMeanings.en: to pay to use something for a short time
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We decided to hire a car for the weekend.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hafta sonu için bir araba kiralamaya karar verdik.

extraMeanings.en: to show great respect for someone, often publicly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They held a ceremony to honor the fallen soldiers.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şehit askerleri onurlandırmak için bir tören düzenlediler.

extraMeanings.en: to keep a promise or agreement
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The company promised to honor the original contract.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şirket asıl sözleşmeyi yerine getirmeye söz verdi.

extraMeanings.en: to organize an event or provide the place for it
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Our city will host the Olympic Games next year.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şehrimiz gelecek yıl Olimpiyat Oyunlarına ev sahipliği yapacak.

extraMeanings.tr: ne kadar ... olursa olsun, nasıl ... olursa olsun
extraMeanings.en: to whatever degree or in whatever way
extraMeanings.exampleEn: However hard I try, I can't fix this problem.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ne kadar uğraşırsam uğraşayım, bu sorunu çözemiyorum.

extraMeanings.en: the general impression that a person or organization gives to the public
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The company spent millions to improve its public image.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şirket kamuoyundaki imajını iyileştirmek için milyonlar harcadı.

extraMeanings.en: the force of one object hitting another
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The car was badly damaged on impact with the wall.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Araba duvara çarpması sonucu ağır hasar gördü.

extraMeanings.en: to affect the way someone or something develops or behaves
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Advertising can strongly influence what people buy.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Reklamlar insanların ne satın alacağını güçlü şekilde etkileyebilir.

extraMeanings.en: one edition of a magazine or newspaper
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Did you read the latest issue of the magazine?
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Derginin en son sayısını okudun mu?

extraMeanings.en: to officially give out or announce something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The police issued a warning about the storm.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Polis fırtınayla ilgili bir uyarı yayımladı.

extraMeanings.en: a situation where movement is blocked, especially traffic
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We were stuck in a traffic jam for two hours.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İki saat boyunca trafik sıkışıklığında mahsur kaldık.

extraMeanings.en: to push something into a tight space or make it stuck
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The paper jammed in the printer again.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kâğıt yazıcıda yine sıkıştı.

extraMeanings.en: to say funny things or not be serious
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Don't get angry, I was only joking.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kızma, sadece şaka yapıyordum.

extraMeanings.en: a student in the third year of high school or college in the US
extraMeanings.exampleEn: My sister is a junior at the state university.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kız kardeşim eyalet üniversitesinde üçüncü sınıf öğrencisi.

extraMeanings.en: to hit a door or surface to make a noise, or to bump into something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Someone knocked on the door late at night.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Gece geç saatte birisi kapıyı çaldı.

extraMeanings.en: the process of giving birth to a baby
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She went into labor early this morning.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu sabah erkenden doğum sancısı başladı.

extraMeanings.en: to not have something, or not have enough of it
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The plan lacks any real detail.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Plan gerçek bir ayrıntıdan yoksun.

extraMeanings.en: a page or image that is wider than it is tall
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Print the photo in landscape rather than portrait.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Fotoğrafı dikey yerine yatay olarak yazdır.

extraMeanings.en: a scientific rule that describes how something always happens
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Newton's law of gravity explains why objects fall.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Newton'un yerçekimi yasası nesnelerin neden düştüğünü açıklar.

extraMeanings.en: to give money that must be paid back, usually with interest
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The bank agreed to lend us the money for the house.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Banka ev için bize para vermeyi kabul etti.

extraMeanings.en: a smaller amount of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: You should eat less sugar to stay healthy.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sağlıklı kalmak için daha az şeker yemelisin.

extraMeanings.en: an official document giving permission to do or own something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: You need a license to drive a car.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Araba kullanmak için bir ehliyete ihtiyacın var.

extraMeanings.en: probably
extraMeanings.exampleEn: It will most likely rain this afternoon.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Büyük olasılıkla bu öğleden sonra yağmur yağacak.

extraMeanings.en: to put a large amount of something onto a vehicle, or to fill a program with data
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They loaded the boxes onto the truck.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kutuları kamyona yüklediler.

extraMeanings.en: a large amount or number of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There were loads of people at the concert.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Konserde bir sürü insan vardı.

extraMeanings.en: a person who lives in a particular area
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The locals were very friendly to the tourists.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yöre halkı turistlere karşı çok cana yakındı.

extraMeanings.en: to fasten something with a lock
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Don't forget to lock the door when you leave.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çıkarken kapıyı kilitlemeyi unutma.

extraMeanings.en: too bright or showy in a way that is not attractive
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He was wearing a loud orange shirt.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Cırtlak turuncu bir gömlek giyiyordu.

extraMeanings.en: quiet, or deep in sound
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She spoke in a low voice so no one could hear.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kimse duymasın diye alçak sesle konuştu.

extraMeanings.en: feeling sad or without energy
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He's been feeling low since he lost his job.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İşini kaybettiğinden beri kendini moralsiz hissediyor.

extraMeanings.en: extremely enthusiastic about something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She's mad about horses and rides every day.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Atlara bayılıyor ve her gün biniyor.

extraMeanings.en: the use of special powers to make impossible things happen
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The children believed in magic and fairy tales.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar sihre ve peri masallarına inanıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: the main subject a student studies at university
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Her major is history at the university.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Üniversitedeki ana dalı tarih.

extraMeanings.en: the way in which a person behaves toward others
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The doctor had a calm and friendly manner.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Doktorun sakin ve cana yakın bir tavrı vardı.

extraMeanings.en: to make a mark on something, or to check and grade work
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The teacher marked all the exams over the weekend.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen hafta sonu tüm sınavları değerlendirdi.

extraMeanings.en: relating to physical things and money rather than emotions or ideas
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Money brought him material comfort but not happiness.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Para ona maddi rahatlık getirdi ama mutluluk getirmedi.

extraMeanings.en: to have a particular meaning, or to intend something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: What does this word mean in English?
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu kelime İngilizcede ne anlama geliyor?

extraMeanings.en: to briefly speak or write about something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She mentioned that she might be late.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Geç kalabileceğinden bahsetti.

extraMeanings.en: to succeed in dealing with a difficult situation
extraMeanings.exampleEn: It's not much money, but we'll manage somehow.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Fazla para değil ama bir şekilde idare edeceğiz.
